audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer labels the matchup FAV but rates difficulty 7.5/10 and calls it a 'Tricky matchup', against a 55.43% Malphite win rate over 1068 games.
audit.why: A favoured 55.4% lane is not 7.5/10 hard. The difficulty here is one specific skill check — engaging before Spell Flux lands — not a general uphill.
audit.corrected: Favoured, 5.5/10: he owns Level 1 and reclaims the duel at 2+ items, you own Levels 3-5, Level 6 and the first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[4] gives Level 6 to Ryze, while the content layer on the same matchup calls Level 6 'your single biggest spike' and the Level 6 spike card calls Unstoppable Force 'your kill button'.
audit.why: Malphite gains a 1000-range dash and knockup on a 130s cooldown at 6; Ryze gains Realm Warp, a 180s delayed group teleport with no combat power. Level 6 is Malphite's.
audit.corrected: Level 6 belongs to Malphite. Ryze's real spikes are mana stacking through Arcane Mastery and 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Rune Prison a root six separate times ('his W root', 'trade back through a root', 'knock him up out of his W root'). Rune Prison only roots a target that already has Flux on it — otherwise it is a slow.
audit.why: Riot text, Rune Prison: 'Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' Spell Flux (E) is what applies Flux, on a 3.5s cooldown falling to 2.5s. Separately, Overload's passive is 'Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload' — that reset chain, not raw Q cooldown, is why the poke never stops.
audit.corrected: Spell Flux is the tell, not Rune Prison. Engage before Flux lands and his W is only a slow; let Flux stick and the same button roots you into the Overload reset chain.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'his only escape from my R is realm warp on a huge cooldown' presents Realm Warp as an escape from a knockup.
audit.why: Realm Warp is 180/160/140s and Riot's text is 'creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported' — a delayed group teleport, not a reactive escape. Nothing in the kit supports using it to dodge Unstoppable Force.
audit.corrected: Realm Warp is 180s at rank 1 and only teleports after a delay, so it does not answer a knockup.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid and content.late are written in the first person — 'This is where I flip it', 'my splash autos', 'My R is still a game-winner'.
audit.why: Every other matchup on the site addresses the reader in the second person; first-person coaching text reads like a stray draft.

edits.before: Ryze owns the very first levels — his Q-E root combo and W root let him chain poke while your Granite Shield is your only buffer and your W armor and E shockwave aren't online yet. Don't try to trade back through a root at level 2; just farm with the tip of your Q (Seismic Shard) to grab the movement-speed steal and disengage so Granite Shield refreshes. His Q out-ranges your everything, so accept the chip and respect that a landed E-Q root can set up a full combo or a jungle gank.
edits.after: Ryze owns the very first levels, but know what actually roots you: Rune Prison (W) only roots if Spell Flux (E) is already on you — clean, it is just a slow. Overload (Q) reaches 1000 and every other spell he casts resets it, so the poke never stops. Farm at the 625 tip of Seismic Shard for the move-speed steal, step out so Granite Shield refreshes, and treat a landed Spell Flux as the gank warning, not the Q. His Q out-ranges everything you have.

edits.before: This is where I flip it. With W's bonus armor empowering my splash autos and E's shockwave both scaling off armor, I start farming through his poke instead of eating it. At 6 Unstoppable Force is the whole lane — R through a minion or flash-R to knock him up out of his W root, then E-W-auto and Q-chase the slow before he can flux-Q reset away. Bait his W root or his Flash, then commit; his only escape from my R is realm warp on a huge cooldown.
edits.after: This is where you flip it. Ground Slam's damage scales off your armour, so every point you buy is offence as well as defence and you farm through his poke instead of eating it. At 6, Unstoppable Force is the whole lane — go before Spell Flux lands, because without Flux his Rune Prison is only a slow, then E-W-auto and Q-chase. Realm Warp is no escape: 180s at rank 1, and the portal only teleports after a delay.

edits.before: I'm a favoured frontline through first item, but Ryze is the textbook raid-boss scaler — once he hits full mana stacks and 2+ items his Q spam out-ranges and out-DPS's my armor stacking, and his ranged kiting never lets me connect. My R is still a game-winner when I flank him for the team, but the straight 1v1 belongs to him late. Win the lane on my 6 and first-item spike, group, and use Unstoppable Force to delete him in a fight rather than chase him in a sidelane he can warp out of.
edits.after: You are the favoured frontline through first item, but Ryze is the textbook scaler — Arcane Mastery converts his mana into damage, and with Overload reset by every other cast his 1000-range poke out-ranges your armour stacking. Your R is still a game-winner when you flank for the team, but the straight 1v1 goes to him late. Win it on your 6 and first-item spike, group, and use Unstoppable Force to delete him in a fight instead of chasing him down a sidelane.

notes: The single biggest fix here: Rune Prison is not a root. Riot's text makes rooting conditional on Flux already being applied by Spell Flux (E), and the page asserted 'his W root' six times, which teaches the wrong tell — a player watching for W will engage into the one state where it actually roots. Could NOT fix inside the length band: full phases[4].side reads 'Ryze' for Level 6 while both layers' prose call Level 6 Malphite's biggest spike; 'Ryze' (4 chars) to 'Malphite' (8) is +100% and would be rejected, so that field needs a manual flip. Malphite kit-flag misfires again avoided: Seismic Shard and Ground Slam carry a 'grounding' flag Riot's descriptions do not support, so I claimed no dash denial against Ryze (who has none anyway).
